messages.content: Here's the JD for an engineer we need to fill: Senior Full-Stack Engineer — 5+ years across Core Java, Spring, REST API design, Angular, SQL/relational databases, AWS deployment, and Docker. Will own end-to-end microservice delivery, contribute to architectural decisions, and mentor mid-level engineers.
That JD spans several areas. Is this a backend-leaning role or true full-stack?
Backend-leaning. Core Java and Spring are day-one priorities, SQL is constant.
Is the seniority closer to a senior IC or tech lead?
Senior IC. They lead design on their own services but don't manage others directly.
